name: CatchGist
tagline: Text to speech for long articles when reading takes too long.
description: CatchGist is text to speech for people who get through long material more easily by listening. Add a link, PDF, webpage, pasted text, or image, choose a voice, and hear the gist first. You can interrupt, read along with the written outline and main points, or listen to the full text. 10 free uses, no account needed to start. Paid packs are one-time, $2.99 or $9.99, not a subscription.
